raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Upper Body Program for Climber with Shoulder Impingement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Upper-body strength and scapular control without overhead loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Restore Control and Capacity" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Scapular Control + Push-Pull Foundation":
        warmup:
          bike 6m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular wall slide (no overhead end-range) 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          prone Y (thumbs up to pain-free) 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable row neutral grip 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline push-up hands elevated 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable external rotation 0º abduction 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          landmine press unilateral 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          kettlebell suitcase carry right 3x30..40m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          kettlebell suitcase carry left 3x30..40m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Horizontal Pull Emphasis + Scapular Upward Rotation":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          serratus wall slide with foam roller 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          chest-supported dumbbell row 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable face pull to eye level 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          incline dumbbell press low incline 20..30deg 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          half-kneeling landmine press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          wrist extensor eccentric 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Scapular Control + Push-Pull Foundation":
        warmup:
          bike 6m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular wall slide (no overhead end-range) 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          prone Y (thumbs up to pain-free) 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable row neutral grip 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline push-up hands elevated 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable external rotation 0º abduction 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          landmine press unilateral 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          kettlebell suitcase carry right 3x40..50m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          kettlebell suitcase carry left 3x40..50m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Horizontal Pull Emphasis + Scapular Upward Rotation":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          serratus wall slide with foam roller 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          chest-supported dumbbell row 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable face pull to eye level 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          incline dumbbell press low incline 20..30deg 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          half-kneeling landmine press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          wrist extensor eccentric 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progressive Rows + Pressing in Safe Range":
        warmup:
          bike 7m
        main straight_sets:
          prone Y (thumbs up to pain-free) 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable row neutral grip 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          incline push-up lower height 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          landmine press unilateral 4x8 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          cable external rotation 0º abduction 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          reverse fly cable 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          kettlebell suitcase carry right 3x50..60m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          kettlebell suitcase carry left 3x50..60m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Horizontal Pull Volume + Scapular Control":
        warmup:
          rower 7m
        main straight_sets:
          serratus wall slide with foam roller 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chest-supported dumbbell row 5x8..10 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          cable face pull to eye level 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          incline dumbbell press low incline 20..30deg 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          half-kneeling landmine press 4x8 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          pallof press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Strength Technique + Stability":
        warmup:
          bike 7m
        main straight_sets:
          prone Y (thumbs up to pain-free) 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated cable row neutral 5x8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          incline push-up lower height 4x8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          landmine press unilateral 4x8 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          cable external rotation 0º abduction 3x15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          reverse fly cable 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          farmer carry neutral grip 2x40..60m rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Volume Consolidation + Deload Tension":
        warmup:
          rower 7m
        main straight_sets:
          serratus wall slide with foam roller 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chest-supported dumbbell row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable face pull to eye level 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          incline dumbbell press low incline 20..30deg 3x8 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          half-kneeling landmine press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          pallof press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 2m
  PHASE "Phase 2: Strength and Endurance for Climbing" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Row Strength + Landmine Press":
        warmup:
          bike 7m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular push-up pain-free range 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chest-supported row paused 1s 5x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          landmine press unilateral 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline dumbbell press neutral grip 3x8 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          cable external rotation 0º abduction 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face pull to external rotation 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          suitcase carry march right 3x30..40m rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          suitcase carry march left 3x30..40m rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 55m "Horizontal Pull Density + Antirotation":
        warmup:
          rower 7m
        main straight_sets:
          serratus wall slide with foam roller 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated cable row wide neutral 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable face pull to eye level 4x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          push-up to boxes 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          half-kneeling landmine press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          pallof press 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Progress Load Safely":
        warmup:
          bike 7m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular push-up pain-free range 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chest-supported row paused 1s 5x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          landmine press unilateral 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          incline dumbbell press neutral grip 3x8 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          cable external rotation 0º abduction 3x15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          reverse fly cable 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          suitcase carry march right 3x40..50m rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          suitcase carry march left 3x40..50m rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 55m "Pull Volume + Tendon Time":
        warmup:
          rower 7m
        main straight_sets:
          serratus wall slide with foam roller 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated cable row wide neutral 4x10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable face pull to eye level 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          incline dumbbell press neutral grip 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          half-kneeling landmine press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          pallof press 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 2m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength Emphasis":
        warmup:
          bike 7m
        main straight_sets:
          prone Y (thumbs up to pain-free) 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          one-arm cable row split-stance 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          landmine press unilateral 5x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          incline dumbbell press neutral grip 3x8 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          cable external rotation 0º abduction 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face pull to external rotation 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          farmer carry neutral grip 3x40..60m rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 55m "Capacity and Control":
        warmup:
          rower 7m
        main straight_sets:
          serratus wall slide with foam roller 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chest-supported row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable face pull to eye level 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          push-up to boxes 3x10 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          half-kneeling landmine press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          pallof press 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 2m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Deload and Groove":
        warmup:
          bike 6m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular push-up pain-free range 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          chest-supported row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          landmine press unilateral 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline dumbbell press neutral grip 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable external rotation 0º abduction 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face pull to eye level 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          suitcase carry right 2x40m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          suitcase carry left 2x40m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 2m
  PHASE "Phase 3: Performance and Power (No Overhead)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Power Rows + Stable Pressing":
        warmup:
          bike 7m
        main straight_sets:
          banded scapular retraction 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chest-supported row explosive up 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          landmine press unilateral 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          incline dumbbell press neutral grip 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable external rotation 0º abduction 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          reverse fly cable 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          farmer carry heavy 3x30..40m rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 55m "Pull Endurance + Anti-Rotation":
        warmup:
          rower 7m
        main straight_sets:
          serratus wall slide with foam roller 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated cable row wide neutral 4x10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable face pull to eye level 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          push-up to boxes 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          half-kneeling landmine press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          pallof press iso hold 3x20..30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength Peak Within Tolerance":
        warmup:
          bike 7m
        main straight_sets:
          banded scapular retraction 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chest-supported row 5x5 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          landmine press unilateral 5x4..5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          incline dumbbell press neutral grip 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable external rotation 0º abduction 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face pull to external rotation 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          farmer carry heavy 3x40m rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 55m "Volume Support":
        warmup:
          rower 7m
        main straight_sets:
          serratus wall slide with foam roller 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated cable row wide neutral 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable face pull to eye level 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          push-up to boxes 3x10 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          half-kneeling landmine press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          pallof press 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Consolidate Strength":
        warmup:
          bike 6m
        main straight_sets:
          banded scapular retraction 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chest-supported row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          landmine press unilateral 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          incline dumbbell press neutral grip 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable external rotation 0º abduction 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          reverse fly cable 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          farmer carry heavy 2x40m rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Deload Readiness":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          serratus wall slide with foam roller 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          seated cable row wide neutral 3x8 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          cable face pull to eye level 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          push-up to boxes 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          half-kneeling landmine press 2x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          pallof press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 2m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Test Tolerances (No Overhead)":
        warmup:
          bike 6m
        main straight_sets:
          banded scapular retraction 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chest-supported row 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          landmine press unilateral 3x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          incline dumbbell press neutral grip 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable external rotation 0º abduction 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face pull to eye level 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Recovery and Mobility":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          serratus wall slide with foam roller 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          seated cable row neutral 3x8 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          incline push-up hands elevated 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          pallof press iso hold 2x20..30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          wrist extensor eccentric 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 3m
